title: A Recipe For Building a Compliant Real Estate Chatbot
findings: The paper found that their fine-tuned model successfully identified and refused to answer non-compliant user queries seeking real estate recommendations based on religion (e.g., finding neighborhoods for Christians), in adherence to the Fair Housing Act. In contrast, powerful baseline models like GPT-4o answered such queries directly, thereby engaging in discriminatory 'steering' by recommending specific neighborhoods based on religious affiliation.
references: Anusha Bagalkotkar, Aveek Karmakar, Gabriel Arnson, and Ondrej Linda. 2024. Fairhome: A fair housing and fair lending dataset.
